race.description: Avon Valley Toyota Fotf – Sunday 25 Oct Hcp (C5)
race.comment: SHOW THE WAY (5) won at this track last start, beating Flying South by a long neck, and has the confidence of a fresh success to carry forward. He's expected to have come on fromt hat performance and with a favourable set up once again, he can continue his winning ways. GIRLS ON FIRE (6) has been plain in two runs back, but the weight relief, Chris Parnham booking and third-up profile give her a pathway into the placings if she finds a stronger finish. PAT'S LAST BANG (10) has disappointed her past couple, but getting out in trip now is a big tick and with a positive ride expected from Steve Parnham, she can put her best foot forward. LIEUTENANT DUNBAR (9) was too good last start and can't be discounted.
